rules.normalization: Trim Unicode whitespace at both ends; exact case-sensitive equality against any alias. No Unicode folding.
Trim Unicode whitespace; accept only optional ASCII minus and ASCII decimal digits; parse i64; compare integer.
Only Python pure functions in authorized Linux Docker; positional JSON args; exact JSON output; no host fallback.
rules.result: passed/total assertions and all_passed; unavailable sandbox is blocked, never zero

rules.normalization: Strict JSON status/answer/citations; exact status; answer trimmed matches an alias (unanswerable: nonempty explanation); citations match the expected source/span set, one-based inclusive. Answer and citation results separate.
rules.result: answer correctness and citation correctness separately

rules.normalization: Strict single JSON value; validate supplied schema; compare whole expected JSON semantically; object order ignored, array order retained.
Exactly one actual Provider tool_calls entry; matching function name and parsed arguments; validate declared parameter schema; no tool execution. Text JSON is not a tool call.
